talking_points.headline: Citi and BNP Paribas turn cautious on HSBC just as Morgan Stanley raises its target
source_links: Citi downgrades HSBC to 'neutral' after 40% run
talking_points.context_html: The first rating actions since the Q2 beat show the street is now debating how much further HSBC's re-rating can run — a sentiment shift worth tracking as it shapes the internal narrative around the bank's simplification and AI-transformation story. Citi cut HSBC to 'neutral' from 'buy', trimming its price target to 1570p — the argument isn't that anything has gone wrong operationally, but that the shares need a breather after a 40% run this year. Exane BNP Paribas downgraded HSBC to underperform on margin-headwind concerns, while Morgan Stanley raised its target to 1,674p from 1,527p — a genuine split verdict three days after Elhedery's on-camera comments about buybacks and the bank overhaul. Sharpens last week's 'Q2 beat splits analysts' storyline with the specific rating actions behind it.

talking_points.headline: OCBC and UOB convert Singapore's wealth boom into record Q2 profits
source_links: OCBC, UOB beat forecasts as wealth income cushions margin
talking_points.context_html: Direct APAC wealth competitors are now showing the hard P&L payoff of fee-income growth offsetting NIM compression — the exact conversion metric HSBC's own Asia wealth franchise and change programme will be benchmarked against. OCBC's Q2 net profit jumped 22% to S$2.22bn, its first quarter above S$2bn, with non-interest income up 51% YoY and wealth management now 41% of group revenue. UOB's profit rose 10% to S$1.48bn, with fee income up 5% to S$665m on record wealth management revenue. Extends the 'Singapore's Big Three' wealth-fee story from earlier in the week with the specific quarterly numbers behind it.

HSBC News.title: Citi, BNP Paribas downgrade HSBC after 40% share rally; Morgan Stanley lifts target
HSBC News.summary: Citi cut HSBC to 'neutral' from 'buy' and trimmed its price target to 1570p, arguing the stock needs a breather after a 40% run this year even though nothing has gone wrong operationally. Exane BNP Paribas separately downgraded HSBC to underperform on margin-headwind concerns, while Morgan Stanley raised its target to 1,674p from 1,527p, leaving analysts split on the post-earnings trade.

Competitor Intelligence.title: OCBC, UOB post record Q2 profits as wealth income offsets margin pressure
Competitor Intelligence.summary: OCBC's Q2 net profit jumped 22% to S$2.22bn, crossing S$2bn for the first time, as non-interest income surged 51% year-on-year and wealth management climbed to 41% of group revenue. UOB's profit rose 10% to S$1.48bn, with fee income up 5% to S$665m on record wealth management revenue, as both banks offset net interest margin compression with fee growth.
